Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 37

“Therefore we ought not to kill the sons of Dhritarashtra, our own kinsmen. For how could we be happy, Madhava, having killed our own people?”

The conclusion of his case, and it rests on happiness rather than on law. Arjuna asks what kind of life follows a victory like this, which no rule about permitted killing can answer.
